# endoflife.date v1 response excerpts

On 2026-11-27 (UTC) these responses were fetched from the endoflife.date API.

- [Node.js](https://endoflife.date/api/v1/products/nodejs/)
- [Python](https://endoflife.date/api/v1/products/python/)
